name: MiMo-V2.6-Pro
description: MiMo-V2.6-Pro is Xiaomi's MIT-licensed omnimodal sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 1.02T total parameters and 42B active parameters. It supports text, image, video, and audio understanding with a 1,048,576-token context window and text output. MiMo-V2.6 scales reinforcement learning across coding, general agents, visual tasks, and cybersecurity. Xiaomi's launch article is dated September 22, 2026; released weights are named MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL. Benchmark results are Xiaomi-reported release evaluations, distinct from intermediate live-training checkpoints. UltraSpeed serves the same model at higher speed for $4.35 input and $8.70 output per million tokens.
